In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of RBF network and the attribute reduction methods based on information entropy is the best combination in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and F1 measure.
the combination of RBF network classifier and attribute selection based on conditional entropy has given better results in terms of classification accuracy and false alarm rate.
the combination of Projective Adaptive Resonse Theory and Sequential Minimal Optimization classifiers with the entropy based feature reduction methods have shown the best results.
